# pve_storage_cephfs (Data Source)

Reads a CephFS storage definition from `GET /storage/{storage}` (type `cephfs`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_storage_cephfs" "cephfs1" {
  storage = "cephfs1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `storage` (String) The storage identifier to look up.

### Read-Only

- `content` (Set of String) Allowed content types (PVE `pve-storage-content-list`), for example `images` or `rootdir`.
- `digest` (String) The read-only storage configuration revision (PVE `digest`).
- `disable` (Boolean) Whether the storage is disabled.
- `fs_name` (String) The Ceph filesystem name (PVE `fs-name`).
- `fuse` (Boolean) Whether the CephFS is mounted through FUSE.
- `keyring` (String, Sensitive) Client keyring contents for external clusters.
- `monhost` (String) Comma-separated list of monitor addresses of the Ceph cluster.
- `nodes` (String) Comma-separated list of cluster node names the storage applies to.
- `path` (String) File system path where the CephFS is mounted.
- `subdir` (String) Subdirectory mounted from the CephFS.
- `type` (String) The storage type, always `cephfs` for this data source.
- `username` (String) The Ceph user name used to authenticate.
